```{r}
library(anndataR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(slingshot)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
adata <- read_h5ad("carpall_scvi_integrated_annotated.h5ad", as = "SingleCellExperiment")
adata
exclude <- c("Early: gdT", "Product")
keep <- !(as.character(adata$labels) %in% exclude)
adata <- adata[, keep]
adata$labels <- droplevels(adata$labels)

table(adata$labels)
```

```{r}
dimred <- reducedDim(adata, "X_umap")
clustering <- adata$labels
counts <- assay(adata, "counts")
```

```{r}
set.seed(61)
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = counts)
)

reducedDim(sce, "UMAP") <- dimred
colData(sce)$labels <- clustering

sce <- slingshot(
  sce,
  clusterLabels = "labels",
  reducedDim = "UMAP",
  start.clus = c("Early: CD8 TCM"),
  allow.breaks=T,
  omega=T,
  stretch=1,
  approx_points=300
)
```

### summary of results
```{r}
SlingshotDataSet(sce)
```

### save object to not have to run again
```{r}
saveRDS(sce, file = "carpall_integrated_slingshot_object.rds")
#sce <- readRDS("carpall_integrated_slingshot_object.rds")
```

```{r}
mst <- slingMST(sce)

nodes <- data.frame(
  cluster = V(mst)$name,
  do.call(rbind, vertex_attr(mst, "coordinates"))
)

colnames(nodes)[2:3] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

nodes
```

```{r}
edge_list <- as.data.frame(get.edgelist(mst))

colnames(edge_list) <- c("from", "to")
```

```{r}
edges <- edge_list %>%
  left_join(
    nodes %>% dplyr::rename(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2),
    by = c("from" = "cluster")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    nodes %>% dplyr::rename(xend = UMAP_1, yend = UMAP_2),
    by = c("to" = "cluster")
  )

edges
```

```{r}
cell_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP_1 = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[,1],
  UMAP_2 = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[,2],
  labels = sce$labels
)

p <- ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = labels), size = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(
    data = edges,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xend = xend,
      yend = yend
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
    geom_point(
    data = nodes,
    aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "carpall_inetgrated_pseudotime_MST_umap.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
```

```{r}
curves <- slingCurves(sce)
curves
```

```{r}
curve_dfs <- lapply(seq_along(curves), function(i) {

  crv <- curves[[i]]

  data.frame(
    UMAP_1 = crv$s[,1],
    UMAP_2 = crv$s[,2],
    lineage = paste0("Lineage_", i),
    order = seq_len(nrow(crv$s))
  )
})

curve_df <- do.call(rbind, curve_dfs)
curve_df$lineage <- gsub("_", "", curve_df$lineage)
#curve_df <- filter(curve_df, lineage %in% c("Lineage1", "Lineage2", "Lineage3"))
```


```{r}
lin <- slingLineages(sce)

terminal_cluster <- sapply(lin, tail, 1)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(cell_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2)) +

  # --- cells (cluster colour scale 1)
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = labels),
    size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 20
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +

  # --- lineages (second independent colour scale)
  geom_path(
    data = curve_df,
    aes(
      UMAP_1,
      UMAP_2,
      group = lineage
    ),
    colour="grey30",
    linewidth = 1,
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.15, "inches"))
  ) +
  theme_classic()
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "carpall_integrated_pseuodtime_lineages_umap.png", dpi = 300, height = 6, width = 8)
```

### add lineage info to cell_df to be able to plot on umap
```{r}
pt <- slingPseudotime(sce)
avg_pt <- rowMeans(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_df <- data.frame(
  cell = names(avg_pt),
  avg_pseudotime = as.numeric(avg_pt)
)

write.csv(avg_df, file = "carpall_integrated_slingshot_average_pseudotime.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
